why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Jackson Merrill is slot #4 (4.675 expected team runs/game).
Slots #4, #3, #5, #2, #1, #6, #7 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #5 ranks 3 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.004 R/G.
Slot #4 yields 4.37 expected PA/game vs 4.26 at primary slot #5. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
